routines.name: analyse-when-asked
routines.title: Run automatically when the dashboard asks
routines.description: When you press Analyse on the dashboard, the desk analyses the stocks waiting there, one at a time, and never places an order.
routines.prompt: Analyse what is waiting on the dashboard.

routines.name: morning-routine
routines.title: Morning routine
routines.description: On weekday mornings: scores past calls, analyses what is waiting and your starred stocks (on Mondays also re-rates what you hold when the desk's view of it is a week old), and lists the new calls to decide on. It never places an order.

routines.name: evening-wrap-up
routines.title: Evening wrap-up
routines.description: On weekday evenings: scores what is ready and tells you the day's calls and the orders the dashboard sent. It never places an order.
